slots.jd.family-contractor.about: Hollis and Sons Electric is a family electrical contractor in Dayton, Ohio. We are owner-run, and the owners still work on the job sites with the crew. We are hiring an Apprentice Electrician to work on site alongside a journeyman and learn the trade on real jobs. You will spend your days at customer sites, not in a shop, as part of a small team that looks out for each other.
slots.jd.family-contractor.duties:
What the job involves
- Trace faults in circuits and equipment with a journeyman and help find the cause
- Read plans and drawings to lay out the work before it starts
- Install panels and connect circuits to them
- Install light fixtures, switches and outlets to the plans
- Keep the work area clean and safe at the end of each day
slots.jd.family-contractor.needs:
What you need
- 2 or more years of experience in electrical work
- Hands-on skill in Panel installation and Troubleshooting
- Blueprint reading and Multimeter use on the job
- Experience with Fire alarm wiring, and Grounding and bonding
- A current Apprentice Registration Card (required)
- A Journeyman Electrician Licence (preferred, not required)
slots.r1.b1: Installs panels and fixtures from the drawings, applying Blueprint reading to set out each run before work starts and cutting layout errors by 40 percent.
slots.r1.b2: Runs conduit across job sites, relying on safe Power tool use to cut, bend and fasten each section to the journeyman's layout.
slots.r1.b3: Pulls and terminates wire for Motor controls circuits, reducing termination callbacks by 50 percent through careful labelling and checks.
slots.r1.b4: Traces faults in circuits and equipment through Multimeter use, then reports findings to the journeyman before any repair is made.
slots.r1.i1: Works on site under a journeyman at Summit Power Contractors, tracing faults in circuits and equipment and helping find their cause.
slots.r1.i2: Reads plans and drawings at Summit Power Contractors to lay out electrical work on site under a journeyman's direction.
slots.summary.1: Apprentice electrician with about 2 years of experience working under a journeyman who checks each job. Applies Troubleshooting, Load calculations and Code compliance on site, with the work reviewed before sign-off.
slots.summary.2: Apprentice-level electrical worker with about 2 years on job sites, completing tasks under a journeyman who reviews the finished work. Skills include Troubleshooting, Load calculations and Code compliance, along with panel installation and blueprint reading.
